resources.title: ESCAPE FROM TARKOV - ICEBREAKER OUT NOW
resources.creator: LVNDMARK
resources.noteEs: Stream completo del lanzamiento del evento Icebreaker — la reacción en vivo del jugador más visto de Tarkov mientras descubre mapa, boss y mecánicas nuevas en tiempo real.
resources.noteEn: Full stream of the Icebreaker event launch — the live reaction of Tarkov's most-watched player as he discovers the new map, boss, and mechanics in real time.

resources.title: ICEBREAKER IS GOING TO CHANGE TARKOV FOREVER! - Escape from Tarkov
resources.creator: Pestily
resources.noteEs: Análisis editorial corto de Pestily sobre por qué el evento Icebreaker representa un cambio estructural en la cobertura del parche, no solo contenido temporal. Lectura honesta del long-term.
resources.noteEn: Pestily's short editorial analysis on why the Icebreaker event represents a structural shift in patch coverage, not just temporary content. Honest read on long-term implications.

resources.title: I Can't Believe this worked with the Icebreaker BOSS.. - Escape From Tarkov
resources.creator: LVNDMARK
resources.noteEs: Strategy improvisada que termina funcionando contra el boss principal del Icebreaker. Útil para ver el discovery process pre-meta cuando la community todavía busca el approach óptimo.
resources.noteEn: Improvised strategy that ends up working against the main Icebreaker boss. Useful to see the pre-meta discovery process when the community is still searching for the optimal approach.

resources.title: DeadlySlob: Escape From Tarkov - Solo Raiding - Day 36
resources.creator: DeadlySlob
resources.noteEs: Día 36 de la serie diaria de DeadlySlob — documenta la progresión solo del wipe atravesando el parche Icebreaker. Útil como termómetro del estado del juego día a día.
resources.noteEn: Day 36 of DeadlySlob's daily series — documents solo wipe progression through the Icebreaker patch. Useful as a day-to-day thermometer for the game's state.

resources.title: NEARLY At IceBreaker...!
resources.creator: Gigabeef
resources.noteEs: Gigabeef recorre el progress de tasks necesarias para alcanzar el contenido Icebreaker. Documenta el gate de quests prerequisitas que separa al casual del endgame del parche.
resources.noteEn: Gigabeef works through the task progression required to reach Icebreaker content. Documents the prerequisite quest gate separating casuals from the patch's endgame.
